svg.title: RadiologyOS AWS cloud infrastructure
svg.desc: Official AWS service-icon architecture of a multi-tenant radiology application in a dedicated VPC, with a public load balancer, private EC2 Auto Scaling and RDS tiers, AWS managed services, historical report retrieval, and GitHub Actions deployment.
svg.text: Dedicated VPC · multi-tenant application · private database · Bedrock RAG · GitHub Actions CI/CD
CI/CD DELIVERY PATH · push to main
ALB public · app / data tiers private
PRIVATE APPLICATION SUBNETS · Auto Scaling Group · min 1 / max 4
PRIVATE DATABASE SUBNETS · no public access
Cognito identity → backend workspace + role checks
Tenant + modality filters on every KB search
Per-user model token usage → superadmin dashboard
RAG returns examples; clinician reviews every draft
Network note: one NAT Gateway / EIP is a cost-saving egress design; ALB uses AWS-managed DNS and the current test listener is HTTP restricted to one configured /32.
